title: Use the issuer clock seam for receiver prompt-proof freshness tests
outcome: Receiver proof freshness tests use the issuer's scripted clock rather than a 30-second real-wall-clock margin, while production expiry and issuer-domain checks retain their behavior.
acceptance: The two receiver proof fixture paths can advance issuer time deterministically without sleeping or enlarging expiry windows.
Behavioral checks still reject expired proofs at entry and the mirror mutation, and valid proofs succeed.
